atomicity: Two consecutive ledger entries, admission then existing receipt, in one durable transaction. Validation/reentry separate commits.
durability: Immutable sources/events/bundle fsynced, directory metadata fsynced; trusted local head advanced last via atomic rename and parent compare under one writer lock. No success or planning from uncommitted candidate. Crash yields old or complete new head.

fields.admission: one ReceiptAdmission bound to entity, producer, target, unique claims and existing independently trusted authentication PredicateId
fields.command_key: content identity of canonical request excluding this key; namespace planner-evidence-command-v1; includes exact parent and request fields
fields.contract_pin: current pinned ingress contract content identity, part of pre-state source table
fields.entity: one GraphEntity EVIDENCE with deterministic EntityId, typed raw-content identity, provenance, exact context scope/lineage/generation, expiry
fields.expected_bundle: ArtifactIdentity CONTENT_IDENTITY/planner-bundle-v1 of exact pre-transaction prefix
fields.expected_parent_event: last ExecutionEvent.identity or null for empty ledger
fields.field_provenance: selectors into new bytes or pinned pre-state ingress/requirement/route/trust records for every inserted field; no implementation defaults
fields.receipt_action: exact gate.receipt_action string, not inferred ActionId
fields.requirements: sorted nonempty distinct EvidenceId subset of gate requirements; proposition and typed target must match pre-state declarations
fields.source_additions: nonempty sorted unique ArtifactPin list for new immutable evidence bytes only; RAW content identities; no replacement pins

permitted_mutations: append new source pins at exact event sequence

idempotence: Canonical request key scoped to parent; identical committed retry returns prior outcome without append; same key/different bytes rejects; replay applies one entry once in sequence.

ordering: Single serialized writer per canonical head; integer ledger sequence and parent identities. Same ordered event input => same identities; do not sort competing live events by hash or treat histories as sets.

persistence_contract.commit_pair: Every admission event must be immediately followed by its same-gate same-entity EVIDENCE_RECEIVED event; no published bundle may end on unpaired admission. Intermediate snapshot exists only privately. Both event identities include pre/post snapshots.
persistence_contract.compatibility: Old bundles with no admission events retain bytes and identities; existing five events and native receipt/validation semantics unchanged. No new unreviewed E2 policy version or scope is admitted.
persistence_contract.reuse: Existing snapshot/bundle/event identity algorithms and source pins; additive closed event registration, no historical initial-state rewrite
persistence_contract.source_schedule: Final bundle sources = initial source set union disjoint source_additions from admitted events. Derive initial set by subtracting additions, replay strictly by sequence, reconstruct each prefix bundle identity for expected_bundle. No newly added source available to earlier prefix. Reject duplicate/replaced/colliding pin keys.
